description: This file extends the AttributedString class to add a method `sentences(maxLength:)` that segments the attributed string into sentences, optionally limiting the length of each sentence. It utilizes natural language processing with NLTokenizer to identify sentence and word boundaries, and constructs attributed substrings enriched with audio timing attributes.

classes.name: AttributedString
classes.description: An extension of the AttributedString class from Swift's Foundation framework, adding sentence segmentation functionality.

methods.name: sentences(maxLength:)
methods.description: Splits the attributed string into sentence-sized substrings, optionally constrained by maximum length, and annotates each with audio time ranges if applicable.
